# Cite the block, not the impression

A citation names a block and a place in the source.

## When to Use This Skill

- citing a paragraph that must survive review

## Inputs

- a retained material
- the block id

## Conditions

- the material is retained

## Limitations

- only as good as the stored revision

## Steps

1. open the block
2. quote it

## Evidence

Every claim above was checked against these places in the recorded material.

- `mat-111111111111111111111111` `ev-aa57eaa6c01ea5b0` at `{"block_id": "blk-0001", "source_url": "https://example.com/a", "type": "web"}`, material revision `rev-1`

## Checks

- positive: Does the quote carry a locator?
